description: This is the main program source file for the DataAssetBackend MigrationRunner, responsible for applying SQL database migrations without Docker. It includes CLI argument parsing, environment variable loading, migration discovery, execution, and history tracking.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: Contains the entry point for the migration runner application, handles command-line parsing, env loading, and orchestrates migration application.

classes.name: ApplyMigrationsFlow
classes.description: Handles the core logic for applying database migrations, including connection management, migration discovery, execution, and transaction handling.

classes.name: MigrationDiscovery
classes.description: Discovers migration files in the specified directory, parsing filenames for versioning and description.

classes.name: MigrationHistory
classes.description: Manages the migration history table in the database, tracking applied migrations and their checksums.

classes.name: DatabaseUrlParser
classes.description: Parses a PostgreSQL URL (DATABASE_URL) into an Npgsql connection string format.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Program entry point; initializes environment, parses args, and runs migration flow.

methods.name: LoadDotEnvIfPresent
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file if it exists, without failing on errors.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses CLI arguments into an ApplyMigrationsRequest object.

methods.name: ResolveMigrationsPath
methods.description: Resolves the migrations directory path from input or default.

methods.name: PrintHelp
methods.description: Displays help message for the CLI usage.

methods.name: NormalizeEnvValue
methods.description: Trims and removes quotes from environment variable values.
